title: Entry changes made by a ledger upgrade (upgradesProcessing) are never indexed, so a base-reserve increase leaves stale num_subentries and liabilities
severity_basis: ProcessLedger builds each ledger from its transactions only and never reads LedgerCloseMeta.UpgradesProcessing, so the account, trustline and offer changes stellar-core writes for a base-reserve upgrade are not indexed and the native_balances and trustline_balances rows keep pre-upgrade num_subentries, minimum_balance and liabilities until a later transaction touches them. No error or halt; latent, since current upgrades write only CONFIG_SETTING entries, which wallet-backend does not store.
caps_note: No CAP applies: base-reserve upgrades and the entry changes stellar-core writes for them predate CAPs.

entries.expected: the account and trustline changes in upgradesProcessing are indexed like other ledger entry changes
entries.observed: No corpus entry holds a base-reserve increase. By hand on a local stellar-core 30.0.0 network (testnet passphrase) with a reserve upgrade from 0.5 to 5 XLM at ledger 21: the upgrade changes four accounts and a trustline and removes three offers, and wallet-backend indexes none of them (num_subentries 2 where the ledger has 1, buying_liabilities 50,000,000 where it has 0).

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs, with the reproduction in the upstream issue; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. The issue's test (internal/indexer/upgrade_changes_test.go) at wallet-backend 18db88f4 on the embedded ledger 21 of a local stellar-core 30.0.0 network: the base-reserve upgrade changes four accounts and a trustline and removes three offers, and the buffer gets no account or trustline change for any of them. An ingest through ledger 27 at 3e22515a (internal/indexer is the same at 18db88f4) left the stale values the issue lists.
evidence.expected_basis: LedgerCloseMeta.upgradesProcessing carries the entry changes stellar-core makes when it applies an upgrade; for a base-reserve increase it erases offers the accounts can no longer support and rewrites their numSubEntries, sponsorship counts and liabilities.

reproduction.method: The run the issue reports, made at 18db88f4 before filing on 2026-11-19: no account or trustline change is buffered for the entries the upgrade changed.

queries: stellar/wallet-backend: every issue and pull request title, open and closed
stellar/wallet-backend: commits since 2026-11-01 on every branch touching the cited files

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-19: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-19 as https://github.com/stellar/wallet-backend/issues/833; this record restates the public issue.
